verification_limits: Six contract sources were subsequently obtained through Sourcify v2 and independently matched by runtime hash; the compiler was not rerun and this is not a full security audit.

Earlier Blockscout API requests returned HTTP 403; legacy Sourcify full-match metadata paths returned HTTP 404 and IPFS retrieval returned HTTP 403. These historical failures do not describe the successful v2 source retrieval.
Public eth_call simulations discarded all state changes; no actual wallet, mint, plant, upgrade, claim, approval, transfer or swap transaction was performed during development.
API snapshots are fetched at separate times; they are not atomic chain-state snapshots.
Reward projection does not replicate accumulator rounding or a depleted Granary. Future prices, paid network costs, supplies, drawings and vesting still need their own evidence.
